widgets_values: A realistic portrait of a young European woman with curly hair, pausing just before a sip of tea. The frame shows her head, shoulders, upper chest and both hands holding a dark ceramic cup at chest height, a hand's width below her chin; her mouth is closed and well clear of the rim. She is turned slightly away from the camera. Warm light from behind her right side grazes her hair against a dark interior wall: the outer edges of her loose curls and a few stray strands glow, with the dark background visible between them, while the dense inner hair stays dark and the highlights break naturally where strands overlap. Her face is only dimly lit by a very weak soft fill from camera left, so most of it stays in soft shadow while her glasses, cheek and fingers remain readable. Only the edges of her ears and shoulders that face the back light catch any light. The cup has a broad, subtle highlight, with contact shadows where her fingers meet it. Focus is sharpest on her glasses, the outer hair strands and the cup rim. She wears a beige spaghetti-strap knit top. Natural, unretouched skin texture without heavy sharpening; clean native-resolution detail with no border, watermark or compression artifacts.

## AMD MiniMax H3 Image Text to Image

Requires a **personal** account key: the shared key is refused with a permission error for this model. Register at https://h3.oneclickamd.ai, then configure it either way below. **One-time setup per machine** — it applies to every workflow:

- Save the key to `h3_gateway_api_key.txt` in the ComfyUI user directory
- Or set the environment variable `H3_GATEWAY_API_KEY`

The same key also works for the AMD MiniMax H3 video and AMD Qwen Image 2.1 nodes, so configure it once.

**On the Windows Desktop app, use the file.** Desktop starts from the Start menu and does not inherit variables you set in PowerShell. It belongs in Desktop's install directory, for example `C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Local\Comfy-Desktop\ComfyUI-Installs\ComfyUI\ComfyUI\user\h3_gateway_api_key.txt`. Make it with Notepad: the default encoding is right, and **New > Text Document** already ends in `.txt`.

If the key is missing, the node fails immediately and tells you the registration URL and the exact file path, so you never sit through a silent 401.

**Your key is not in this workflow.** The node has no `api_key` widget, so the key is never written into the workflow JSON or embedded into exported image metadata. This workflow is safe to share.

If you run your own gateway, override the default address with `H3_GATEWAY_BASE_URL`.

**Parameters:** `aspect_ratio` six ratios. `size` is `1K` (about 1MP, 4 credits) or `2K` (about 4MP, 2048x2048 at 1:1, 16 credits); this example runs at `2K`, and the first run with seed 42 reproduces the thumbnail. The same prompt, ratio, size and `seed` give the same image; set the seed control to `fixed` to keep one. Connect reference images to `images` and the same node edits them instead.

**Prompting:** the model reads a detailed description of the whole image best: subject, framing, light direction and strength, focus and wardrobe. There is no negative prompt, so write what to avoid into the prompt itself, as the last sentence of this example does. Describe positions positively ("a hand's width below her chin") rather than with negations.
